optimized_sql:
WITH matched_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        st.s_store_name,
        st.s_company_id,
        st.s_street_number,
        st.s_street_name,
        st.s_street_type,
        st.s_suite_number,
        st.s_city,
        st.s_county,
        st.s_state,
        st.s_zip,
        (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS days_difference
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN store st
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
      AND d2.d_moy = 8
)
SELECT
    m.s_store_name,
    m.s_company_id,
    m.s_street_number,
    m.s_street_name,
    m.s_street_type,
    m.s_suite_number,
    m.s_city,
    m.s_county,
    m.s_state,
    m.s_zip,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.days_difference <= 30) AS "30 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.days_difference > 30 AND m.days_difference <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.days_difference > 60 AND m.days_difference <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.days_difference > 90 AND m.days_difference <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.days_difference > 120) AS ">120 days"
FROM matched_returns m
GROUP BY
    m.s_store_name,
    m.s_company_id,
    m.s_street_number,
    m.s_street_name,
    m.s_street_type,
    m.s_suite_number,
    m.s_city,
    m.s_county,
    m.s_state,
    m.s_zip
ORDER BY
    m.s_store_name,
    m.s_company_id,
    m.s_street_number,
    m.s_street_name,
    m.s_street_type,
    m.s_suite_number,
    m.s_city,
    m.s_county,
    m.s_state,
    m.s_zip
LIMIT 100
